extracted.stage: Pre-grant; IHT payable before grant of probate can be applied for
extracted.summary: A private client solicitor acting for the executors of an illiquid Chester estate valued at about £1,049,000 enquires about borrowing £64,000 to pay the inheritance tax due before the grant can be applied for.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of the executors; we have logged it for review by our underwriting team. To take this further we will need confirmation of the executors' details and their consent to proceed, a breakdown of the estate's assets and liabilities, and the IHT400 or computation showing the £64,000 figure. It would also help to have the date by which the tax must be paid, details of any other funding or liquidity available to the estate, and confirmation of your firm's engagement. Nothing in this message constitutes an offer of finance or any indication of terms. We will come back to you once we have reviewed the information provided.
